named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate was impacted by Hurricane Odile which occurred in September 2014 and damaged a port in Mexico. The current gross outstanding is GBP 3.2m. The remaining outstanding movement is primarily made up of smaller attritional claims that fall below the reinsurance recovery threshold.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 42.677m. During 2014 the gross provision for claims increased by GBP 26.485m to a closing gross outstanding of GBP 71.636m (with the reinsurers' share of claims increasing by GBP 7.220m). The report identifies Hurricane Odile (September 2014) as a named event with a current gross outstanding of GBP 3.2m and notes the remainder of movements comprise smaller attritional claims beneath reinsurance recovery thresholds. The syndicate does not disclose an explicit gross prior-year-only movement figure in the available notes, so a granular prior-year development amount and by-LOB prior-year movements are not provided.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding obtained from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior-year comparative). No explicit gross prior-year-only reserve movement (PYD) figure is presented in the available notes; the Technical Provisions note shows total gross change in claims outstanding for the year (+26.485m) but does not disaggregate prior-year development separately. As a last-resort gross PYD could not be computed from a claims development triangle because no triangle was present in the supplied pages. Named event (Hurricane Odile) and attritional claim commentary are present and used for causal mapping.
